title: Outstandingly Crunchy Indian Shrimp Rasmalai
description: A unique Indian dish featuring shrimp stock, crunchy toast, and low-sodium ingredients, served in a rasmalai form with a bitter twist, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Toast the white bread until crispy and chop into small pieces
In a large pan, combine the shrimp stock, garam masala, and cayenne pepper, and bring to a boil
Add the shrimp to the pan and cook until pink and fully cooked
Add the chopped bitter melon to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes
In a separate bowl, whip the low-fat cream until stiff peaks form
To assemble the rasmalai, place a layer of toasted bread pieces in the bottom of a serving dish
Add a layer of the shrimp and bitter melon mixture on top of the bread
Top with a layer of whipped cream and sprinkle with chopped cilantro
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top
